testing.fixture_style: conftest.py autouse fixtures, monkeypatch, tmp_path; inline helper classes (DummySession, _RecordingAggregator) over complex fixtures

ci_checks: integration-test (4 suites: acp, api, prompt-server, other)

conventions: Ruff rules: E (pycodestyle errors), F (pyflakes), I (isort), TCH (type-checking imports). E501 (line-too-long) is IGNORED.
asyncio_mode = 'strict' in pytest; every async test must use @pytest.mark.asyncio explicitly
Module-level logger: logger = get_logger(__name__) using fast_agent.core.logging.logger.get_logger, not stdlib logging
Logging uses f-strings (dominant pattern), not %-format. Structured data passed via data= kwarg
Type annotations use Python 3.10+ union syntax: str | None, not Optional[str]
Private methods use single underscore prefix: _foo, never __foo (dunder only for magic methods)
Error handling: specific exception types preferred; broad except Exception uses '# noqa: BLE001' comment with reason
Imports: stdlib first, then third-party, then local (fast_agent.*). TYPE_CHECKING block at end of imports for circular-import avoidance
Context manager pattern: @asynccontextmanager from contextlib for generator-based; explicit __aenter__/__aexit__ for class-based
Docstrings: Google-style (Args:, Returns:, Raises:) on public methods; often omitted on private/internal methods
Test helper classes prefixed with underscore: _DummyRegistry, _RecordingAggregator, _SessionStub
Pydantic BaseModel used for data classes with validation; @dataclass for simple containers. frozen=True, slots=True for immutable dataclasses
Constants defined at module level with UPPER_SNAKE: SESSION_NOT_FOUND_ERROR_CODE = -32043
PR body uses ## Summary, ## Problem, ## Change, ## Verification sections
Small focused PRs from external contributors get merged quickly; large unfocused PRs get batch-closed
evalstate squash-merges external PRs (PR number appended to title like '#729')
Custom exceptions inherit from FastAgentError(message, details) -- two-part error messages
Assertions in runtime code: assert used for invariants (assert self._tg is not None), not for validation
anti_patterns: Large unfocused PRs that touch many unrelated areas -- evalstate has batch-closed these
Using stdlib logging instead of fast_agent.core.logging.logger.get_logger
Using Optional[X] instead of X | None
Using %-format strings in logger calls (the codebase uses f-strings)
Missing @pytest.mark.asyncio on async test functions (strict mode will fail)
Double-underscore private methods (__foo) -- the codebase uses single underscore exclusively
Adding # type: ignore comments -- evalstate fixes type issues properly or uses ty's type system
Creating documentation files in the PR without being asked
Tests that require external resources without proper markers (@pytest.mark.e2e or @pytest.mark.integration)
